“I don’t have any,” Lin Yuan said, shaking his head.

Actually, Lin Yuan did have a treasure that could enhance the ultimate probability.

It was the Mysterious Gourd, which could break the shackles of the Inner World.

After absorbing the seven colored liquids of the Mysterious Gourd, the visible size of one’s Inner World could increase more than twentyfold.

As an Eleventh-Rank Life surges toward the ultimate, the Inner World evolves towards an Inner Universe.

...

At this time, the more profound the foundation of the Inner World, the more relaxed the transformation.

In other words, it indirectly increases the chance of breaking through to the ultimate.

But how could Lin Yuan possibly use the Mysterious Gourd for trade?

Even Human Civilization was kept in the dark by Lin Yuan, let alone the Tuoba Ancient God.

Lin Yuan could guess that once he dared to reveal even a hint of information about the Mysterious Gourd,

it would bring about the direct intervention of the Supreme Beings.

To the Supreme Beings, Lin Yuan, no matter how talented or gifted, was only a life within the River of Time.

Unable to leap out of the River of Time, he would eventually die of old age.

Therefore, geniuses were not regarded highly by the Supreme Beings.

But the Mysterious Gourd? It was absolutely a treasure surpassing even the likes of the Eternal Spring and other Twelve-Star cosmic rarities.

Lin Yuan had no doubt that the Supreme Beings would fight over it.

“I know you don’t have any,” the Tuoba Ancient God spoke, “but Human Civilization surely does.”

“The piece of Spirit Will I took is your close friend, the River Star Lord. Could it be that he will just watch indifferently as his memories are lived by me?”

The Tuoba Ancient God said.

Once Fang Qing’s Spirit Will was experienced by the Tuoba Ancient God, it would be utterly obliterated.

“I’ll think about it.”

Lin Yuan did not outright refuse but, after saying these words, he stood up and disappeared.

…

After Lin Yuan left,

this temporarily constructed virtual network world was left with only the Tuoba Ancient God and the Sizhong Ancient God.

“Tuoba!”

The Sizhong Ancient God looked at the Tuoba Ancient God with an extremely unsightly expression, his eyes faintly emitting flames. The Sizhong Ancient God had always presented himself as a good guy and made connections with various factions, but at this moment, he was truly furious.

“A mere piece of Sixth Rank Life’s Spirit Will, do you think it’s worth a treasure that could enhance the probability of breaking through to the ultimate?”

“Even if you hold a grudge against Human Civilization, since I have stepped in, you shouldn’t make such an excessive demand.”

The Sizhong Ancient God said coldly.

“A mere Sixth Rank Life?”

With a faint smile, the Tuoba Ancient God said, “To us, indeed, it is just a Sixth Rank Life, but I have made clear inquiries. That Fang Qing had been gracious to the River Star Lord.”

“The River Star Lord is too young; he probably places great importance on favors. Anyway, I just casually mentioned it. It doesn’t matter if the negotiation breaks down.”

The Tuoba Ancient God said, unconcerned.

Although he also thought the chances were slim that the River Star Lord would produce a treasure to enhance the chance of reaching the ultimate,

what if he did?

If the River Star Lord was so inclined, it would be a great opportunity for him.

Even if, in the end, the River Star Lord truly couldn’t produce anything, he could continue to make other demands. After all, Fang Qing’s Spirit Will was in his hands, and he could manipulate the River Star Lord at any time.

“By doing this, aren’t you afraid of offending the River Star Lord, offending Human Civilization?” After a moment of silence, the Sizhong Ancient God spoke.

After this incident, regardless of the final outcome, the Tuoba Ancient God would have completely offended the River Star Lord.

To have completely offended the River Star Lord was tantamount to having offended Human Civilization.

“I don’t have much life left. What is there to be afraid of?” said the Tuoba Ancient God lightly. “Within a million years, I will attempt to reach the ultimate.

“At that time, if I fail, everything about my existence will be erased. What difference would offending ten River Star Lords make? If I succeed, then I will be a Supreme Being. No matter how furious the River Star Lord is, what can he do?”

The Tuoba Ancient God shook his head and continued, “Sizhong, for the long years, you have been befriending various geniuses, which I find meaningless. Without becoming a Supreme Being, what’s the use of having so many connections?”

“What I do has nothing to do with you,” the Sizhong Ancient God retorted as he looked at Tuoba, “Tuoba, I’m asking you again, do you really want to stand against the River Star Lord?”

“I advise against doing so. The potential of the River Star Lord is the greatest I have ever seen. Your actions could lead to endless troubles,” the Sizhong Ancient God said earnestly.”

“The greatest potential?”

“I will attempt the ultimate within a million years. Could it be that the River Star Lord could reach the ultimate within a million years?”

The Tuoba Ancient God sneered, “Sizhong, stop trying to mediate, I, Tuoba, have got a firm grasp on the River Star Lord.”

“We special beings stand high above all, why should we be concerned with the likes of the River Star Lord?”

“Even if the River Star Lord seeks the help of a Supreme Being from Human Civilization, I can simply swear allegiance to the Insect Race Tianyu Clan. They are more than capable of ensuring my safety.”

The Tuoba Ancient God had considered everything. Even if the River Star Lord’s talent was monstrous, he was not a Supreme Being.

The nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization wouldn’t start a war with the Insect Race Tianyu Clan over the River Star Lord.

After all, nothing had happened to the River Star Lord himself. As for a friend’s death? The Supreme Being of Human Civilization wouldn’t care.

Upon hearing this, the Sizhong Ancient God fell silent once more.

“Now, I’m just waiting for the River Star Lord’s response,”

“I hope there will be a surprise,” the Tuoba Ancient God said, his eyes gleaming with anticipation.

“How about this, Tuoba. You come up with a new condition, and I will meet it on behalf of the River Star Lord,” the Sizhong Ancient God proposed after some thought.

“Sizhong, don’t interfere,”

The Tuoba Ancient God glanced at the Sizhong Ancient God, “To me now, no matter how precious a treasure is, as long as it does not benefit my chance of reaching the ultimate, it’s useless.”

“Unless you too can bring out a treasure that could enhance the chance of reaching the ultimate.”
